Package com.ibm.wsspi.cloud.productinsights

Class MetricGroupDescriptor

java.lang.Object
com.ibm.wsspi.cloud.productinsights.AggregationMethodDescriptor<MetricGroupDescriptor>
com.ibm.wsspi.cloud.productinsights.MetricGroupDescriptor
public class MetricGroupDescriptor extends AggregationMethodDescriptor<MetricGroupDescriptor>
Provides group descriptive information about a reported Metric, that will be used to control how the metric information is displayed.

    • setGroupRollUpMethod

      public MetricGroupDescriptor setGroupRollUpMethod(MetricGroupDescriptor.GroupRollUp groupRollUp)
      Sets the group roll up type method. If not provided, the metric will not be rolled up for parent groups.

      Allowed values:

      • MIN
      • MAX
      • AVG
      • SUM
      • LAST

    • setSliceAggregationMethods

      public MetricGroupDescriptor setSliceAggregationMethods(AggregationMethodDescriptor.SliceAggregationMethod... aggregationMethods)
      Sets the aggregation type methods for small time periods (for example, hours when looking at a day). If not specified, defaults to MIN, MAX, AVG.

      Allowed values:

      • NONE
      • MIN
      • MAX
      • AVG
      • SUM
      • LAST

      The value NONE cannot be combined with other values and will result in the metric not being displayed for small time periods.

      Overrides:
      setSliceAggregationMethods in class AggregationMethodDescriptor<MetricGroupDescriptor>
      Returns:
      a reference to this object

    • setRangeAggregationMethods

      public MetricGroupDescriptor setRangeAggregationMethods(AggregationMethodDescriptor.RangeAggregationMethod... aggregationMethods)
      Sets the aggregation type methods for an entire time range. If not provided, defaults to MIN, MAX, AVG.

      Allowed values:

      • NONE
      • MIN
      • MAX
      • AVG
      • SUM
      • LAST
      • AVG_SUM
      • MIN_SUM
      • MAX_SUM
      • AVG_AVG

      The value NONE cannot be combined with other values and will result in the metric not being displayed for the entire time range.

      a reference to this object
